notes: PrefLib file 00020-00000002.toi (dataset 00020, 'pierce'). Counting rule, as far as we know: Instant runoff, single-winner. 15 ballots with two or more candidates tied at one rank were left out (not counted as blank). A 'Write-In' candidate stands for all write-in votes combined.
party_source: Party preference shown in Pierce County's "November 4, 2008 General Election - Official Results" (https://piercecountywa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/1422/nov2008results), read through search-engine extracts because the county site blocks automated access. Joyce McDonald's Republican affiliation also on Wikipedia ("Joyce McDonald").

label_sources.official_winners: Pierce County November 4, 2008 official results; Wikipedia, "Joyce McDonald".
label_sources.max_ranks: Pierce County used a 3-rank ballot for its 2008 and 2009 ranked-choice races (county sample ballot; every ballot in the file has 3 or fewer ranks).

label_notes: Al Rose and Carolyn Merrival's labels rest on the search extract only; check against the PDF when it can be opened.
